posts.body:
Hi,
I'm currently experiencing an issue with my rpg maker mz. When I booted it up today the program appears almost blank (see picture below). I can still hover over and use the top menu bar including test game, zoom etc. I've tried restarting my computer and reinstalling the rpg maker but still no success. Any solutions or
suggestions is most welcome.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
looks like a damaged or wrong display driver, which happens sometimes especially after a windows update.
And if that is the case, the automatic driver update will not help but install the wrong driver again.
you need to check your computer specifications as to learn the manufacturer of your display chip (usually AMD, nVidia or Intel), then go to their website and download the newest driver setup package.
Run that setup, it will clear out all remains of the old driver and install the correct one.

Hey Andar,
Long story short, I have to use a different computer now for my RPG Maker projects. Due to school restrictions, I can't download RPG Maker on the new computer. So, I re-downloaded RPG Maker on my old computer and transferred it, along with my project, to the new one.
When I first launched RPG Maker, it worked  automatically opening an old project. However, as soon as I booted up the game I’m currently working on, that same issue returned. Now, the broken screen appears no matter what project I open.
Based on that, I assume the display chip isn't the issue? If you could offer any more help, it would be greatly appreciated.
Thank you.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Then most likely a  configuration setting inside that project is damaged.
I have no idea on which one, you would have to test that by replacing files in a copy of the damaged project with ones from the new project; one by one until you found the cause, and then replace only that one in the original damaged project.
I would start with the project file and the packages file in the main directory as those contain only general information, nothing specific to your game.
